description: Header file defining WebSocket protocol interface for XR speech router, including structures, constants, and function prototypes for WebSocket communication and state management.

methods.name: xrsr_protocol_handler_ws
methods.description: Handles WebSocket protocol events for XR speech router.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_init
methods.description: Initializes WebSocket state with provided parameters.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_term
methods.description: Terminates and cleans up WebSocket state.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_host_name_set
methods.description: Sets the host name for WebSocket connection.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_fd_set
methods.description: Sets file descriptors for select() based on WebSocket state.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_handle_fds
methods.description: Handles activity on WebSocket file descriptors.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_connect
methods.description: Establishes WebSocket connection with specified URL and parameters.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_conn_is_ready
methods.description: Checks if WebSocket connection is ready.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_audio_stream
methods.description: Starts or manages audio streaming over WebSocket.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_speech_session_end
methods.description: Ends speech session with specified reason.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_handle_speech_event
methods.description: Handles speech events received over WebSocket.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_is_established
methods.description: Checks if WebSocket connection is established.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_is_disconnected
methods.description: Checks if WebSocket connection is disconnected.

methods.name: xrsr_ws_opcode_str
methods.description: Returns string representation of WebSocket opcode.
